info.description: One step (Design & Create / Issue & Deliver / Share & Verify) in the homepage's 'How it works' walkthrough. feature1..4 are fixed slots (blanks are filtered out on the frontend) rather than a repeatable list, and this component is used via 3 separate fixed fields on the homepage singleType rather than one repeatable list - HomeSection.vue hardcodes a lookup from exactly 3 section ids to 3 specific illustration components, so a freely-addable 4th section would have no illustration to map to.

title.description: Short pill label above the header, e.g. 'Design & Create'.

illustrationImage.description: Replaces the hand-coded inline-SVG illustration when set. Frontend falls back to the original coded illustration if empty.

badgeCalloutTitle.description: Only used by the Design & Create section's Open Badges callout box.
